descripcion: Fotografía a sangre, en primer plano y muy cercana, del momento de frustración o de dolor que vive el cliente: la situación, no el producto. Arriba a la izquierda, sobre un degradado oscuro, un titular grande nombra el problema y un subtítulo corto lo agita o abre la salida. Abajo a la derecha, pequeño y dentro de una tarjeta de color de marca, aparece el producto como la salida. Se siente real, cercano y emocional, no de estudio.
reference_style: Documentary-style close-up photo of a relatable frustration moment, with a bold overlaid headline and the product as a small branded way-out tile

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The close-up of the pain moment (instant emotional recognition). 2) The headline naming the problem. 3) The small product tile in the bottom-right corner as the way out. 4) The short subheadline.
art_direction.composition_style: Full-bleed photographic composition. The camera is very close to the action (tight crop, the subject fills the frame); the main point of interest sits in the center to lower-center of the frame (about 35-65% of the width and 45-75% of the height), so the top-left area stays calmer and darker for the text and the bottom-right corner stays free for the product tile. The product tile is anchored in the bottom-right corner as a separate graphic layer on top of the photo and never covers the pain point.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Text block in the top-left: starts at the 7% margin, spans max 70% of the canvas width and the top 35-40% of the height. Product tile: bottom-right, inset 6% from the right and bottom edges, about 24-28% of the canvas width and 28-32% of the height. The rest of the canvas is pure photo, with no other graphics.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Natural, realistic, slightly cool available light (window, overhead or screen light depending on the scene), mildly desaturated and moody, shallow depth of field with the pain point in sharp focus and a softly blurred background. A dark gradient (black or brand-dark, about 60-70% opacity fading to 0) from the top-left corner gives the text contrast. The product tile is the only warm, saturated, studio-lit element on the canvas.

layout_summary: Square canvas filled edge to edge with a realistic, tight close-up photo of the moment the problem hurts most. A dark diagonal gradient in the top-left corner holds a large white headline (2-3 lines) and a short subheadline under it. In the bottom-right corner, a small rounded tile in the brand color contains the user's product, studio-lit, as the way out. No other elements.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Makes the viewer instantly recognize their own frustration
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Depict the specific moment the problem hurts most for this product's buyer, in an extreme close-up of the action, object or context (e.g. a hand pressing a sore spot, a tangled or broken everyday object, a stain, a messy space, a tired face lit by a screen, a failed attempt). Prefer showing the situation over zooming in on body flaws. Realistic, candid, smartphone-photo authenticity with professional composition; relatable mild frustration, never grotesque or exaggerated. Keep the sharp pain point in the center to lower-center, away from the top-left text area and the bottom-right tile. The product must NOT appear in the photo.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top-left corner, covering about the top 45% and left 75% of the canvas, fading diagonally to transparent
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Gives the text maximum contrast without hiding the photo
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Smooth gradient from black or the darkest brand tone at about 60-70% opacity to fully transparent. No hard edges, no box.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top-left, starting at the 7% margin, over the gradient
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Names the problem exactly as the viewer feels it
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Write the pain hook of this variation's angle. Keep it short so it fits in max 3 lines within 70% of the width.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Directly below the headline, left-aligned with it
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Agitates the problem or hints there is a way out
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One short supporting line that deepens the pain or opens the door to the solution, without naming the product.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom-right corner, inset 6% from the right and bottom edges, about 24-28% of the canvas width and 28-32% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Presents the product as the exit from the pain without breaking the emotional photo
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Rounded rectangle (corner radius about 2.5% of the canvas) filled with the brand primary color or a soft brand gradient, with a soft drop shadow and an optional thin light outline so it separates from the photo.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Inside the way-out tile, centered, about 20-24% of the canvas height; its top may break slightly out of the tile for a 3D pop
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, packaging, label and colors), front or 3/4 view, studio-lit with a subtle glow, the only warm and saturated object on the canvas.

text_layers.text_style: Extra bold sans-serif, each line about 7-8.5% of the canvas height, max 3 lines, left-aligned, white or the lightest palette tone; one key word may use the brand accent
text_layers.guia_texto: Nombra el problema tal como lo vive el cliente, en 4 a 9 palabras: una escena reconocible, una frase que él mismo pensaría o una pregunta incómoda. Sin mencionar el producto y sin señalar atributos personales directos (habla de la situación, no de «¿tienes X?»).

text_layers.text_style: Regular weight sans-serif, about 3.2-3.8% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, left-aligned, white at 85-90% opacity
text_layers.guia_texto: Agita el problema o abre la salida en 5 a 10 palabras: la consecuencia de no resolverlo o la pista de que existe una forma más simple.

mandatory_visual_elements: Full-bleed, realistic close-up photo of the pain moment
Dark diagonal gradient in the top-left corner behind the text
Small brand-colored tile in the bottom-right corner holding the user's product
Shallow depth of field with the pain point in sharp focus
forbidden_additions: Price, discount, offer or urgency badge
Trust seals, guarantee or certification badges
Before/after split or a second photo
Glossy studio look on the photo (it must feel real)
notas_paleta: Colores nativos de la escena para la foto (realistas, algo fríos y desaturados). La paleta de marca aparece solo en la tarjeta del producto y, como máximo, en una palabra clave del titular. El degradado usa negro o el tono más oscuro de la marca.
